run_uma_1p2_surgery: run the CLI to perform checkpoint surgery on a UMA 1.2 model with --checkpoint-in and --output-dir
run_add_omat_rattle_support: run add_omat_rattle_support to add omat_rattle dataset mapping and cloned embeddings to a checkpoint
run_remove_omat_rattle: run remove_omat_rattle to remove omat_rattle entries and resize expert weights from 8 to 7 slots
run_compare_checkpoints: run compare_checkpoints to compare energy and force outputs between two checkpoint files across all tasks
run_create_test_systems: run create_test_systems to generate PBC and non-PBC H2O test systems for validation
